title: One-request sanitized GMGN wallet stats value-shape diagnostic
objective: Use exactly one 7d GMGN stats CLI invocation to classify only the JSON value types and lexical classes of allowlisted wallet-stat metric aliases at recognized root/pnl_stat/stats locations. Do not retain or expose values, identities, raw payload, stdout/stderr, credentials, proxy URLs, addresses, or labels. Use the result solely to repair the parser value-encoding contract.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue more than one CLI/provider request.

Do not print or persist metric values, raw provider payload, raw stdout/stderr, complete exceptions, credentials, proxy URLs, plaintext addresses, labels, token identifiers, or wallet-keyed object keys.
Do not retry, paginate, call holdings, use fallback, Helius, browser, scraping, database, cache, queue, or production writes.
